data.name: Animal Fury
data.description: You gain a bite attack. This is a primary natural attack that deals 1d%1+%2 points of damage. If made as part of a full-attack action with manufactured weapons, the bite attack is made at your base attack bonus - 5, and you add +%3 to the damage roll. You can make a bite attack as part of the action to maintain or break free from a grapple. If the bite attack hits, grapple checks you attempt against the target until the end of the round gain a +2 bonus.|if(SIZE==4,4,3)|STR|floor(STR/2)
